 `f ≫ g = f ≫ h` implies `g = h`. -/

   /-- A morphism `f` is an epimorphism if it can be cancelled when precomposed. -/
   left_cancellation : ∀ {Z : C} (g h : Y ⟶ Z), f ≫ g = f ≫ h → g = h
